name: image-gen
description: Text-to-image and image-to-image generation powered by GPT-image-2

interface.shortDescription: Text-to-image and image-to-image generation powered by GPT-image-2
interface.longDescription: AI image generator using OpenAI's latest gpt-image-2 model. Supports text-to-image and image-to-image modes (up to 2 reference images), aspect ratio control (1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4, 21:9, etc.), resolution tiers (1k/2k/4k), and batch generation up to 4 images per request. PNG output.
